## Brand Strategy
- **Mission:** Supportive, inclusive connections platform where people can meet in a comfortable, equal, healthy way.
- **Core values:** Safe, Inclusive, Equal, Healthy.
- **Positioning:** Connections app built by women, for everyone. Flips traditional gender dynamics -- women make the first move.
- **Brand personality:** Sincere, Supportive, Optimistic, Bold, Witty -- mapped on a scale from vulnerable to hopeful against the customer journey.

## Logo
- **Primary mark:** "Bumble" wordmark with Hive icon (rounded hexagon with three pill-shaped cutouts) on the left side. Custom typeface based on Galano Grotesque.
- **Primary colorway:** Bumble Black on Bumble Yellow field (preferred).
- **Alternate colorways:** Available for specific use cases.
- **Clear space:** Defined by the widest length of the hexagonal hive on all sides.
- **Minimum size:** 20px tall / 7mm tall / 0.28 inches tall.
- **Brand partnerships:** Detailed lock-up system using hive cutout width as unit of space, with separation line rules for horizontal and stacked layouts.
- **App icons:** Hive may stand alone for app store/social media icons only (white mark on yellow field).
- **Misuse rules:** 12 documented "don'ts" including no rotation, no stacking, no effects, no off-brand colors.

## Typography
- **Primary typeface:** Circular (Lineto foundry) -- four weights: Book, Medium, Black, Extra Black (plus italics for each).
- **Hierarchy system:**
  - H1: Extra Black, All Caps, 500% size, set Solid, -10 tracking
  - H2: Black, Sentence Case, 400% size, set Solid, -10 tracking
  - H3: Black, Sentence Case, 200% size
  - Body: Book, Sentence Case, 100% size, 1.5x leading
  - Discretionary paragraph opener: Extra Black, All Caps, 50 tracking
- **Two typographic styles:**
  - Sincere-Style: Circular Black, sentence case, left-aligned, conversational tone.
  - Bold-Style: Circular Black, ALL CAPS, tight tracking (down to -40), bold statements.
- **Set Solid rule:** Leading equals font size for headlines; line breaks use half the leading value.

## Color
- **Primary palette (3 colors):**
  - Bumble Yellow: PMS 123 C / HEX #FFC629 / CMYK 0.19.89.0 / RGB 255.199.44 -- 70% usage
  - Bumble Black: PMS 433 C / HEX #1D252C / CMYK 0.0.0.100 / RGB 29.37.45 -- 20% usage
  - Bumble White: HEX #FFFFFF -- 10% usage
- **Contrast rules:** No yellow text on white backgrounds; no white text on yellow backgrounds. High contrast enforced for all typography and logo usage.

## Graphics
- **Composition system:** Highly detailed grid system categorized by format:
  - Vertical (V): 8-9 columns, margin ratio 9:10
  - Square/Near-Square (S): 10-14 columns, margin ratio 1:1
  - Horizontal (H): 16-28 columns, margin ratio 10:9
- **Grid construction:** Format-specific column counts with detailed margin and spacing rules.
- **Logo placement:** Logo should span 5 columns (4-6 acceptable); three arrangements for app store logos (in-line, stacked, centered).
- **Optical alignment:** Final adjustments made optically rather than strictly to grid.

## Photography
- **Principles:** Inclusiveness, Authenticity, Connection, Empowerment, Fun.
- **Three categories:**
  - User Photography (Direct-to-Camera, Selfie, Activity) -- should look like high-quality phone photos
  - Product Photography (In Situ, In Use) -- slightly higher production value
  - Lifestyle Photography -- candid, genuine moments of connection
- **Casting:** Diverse range of gender, race, age, sexual orientation, body type, ability.
- **Styling:** Authentic to character; no heavy patterns, prints, or visible clothing branding.
- **Technical:** Natural white balance with subtle warmth; avoid heavy retouching; no heavy contrast; avoid overuse of depth of field.
- **Brand color integration:** Subtle references to palette in wardrobe, locations, and styling.

## Applications
- Out-of-home billboards, digital marketing, social media, push notifications, in-app cards, event flyers, event murals, print.
- Detailed examples for each format category (vertical, square, horizontal) with grid application.

## Tone of Voice
- **Voice spectrum:** Sincere > Supportive > Optimistic > Bold > Witty -- mapped against customer journey stages.
  - Sincere (deciding to date): Honest, trustworthy, clear, inviting
  - Supportive (getting started): Empathetic, helpful, constructive, clear
  - Optimistic (testing the waters): Positive, hopeful, encouraging, accepting
  - Bold (getting to know people): Candid, aware, brave, realistic
  - Witty (messages that matter): Playful, humorous, clever, entertaining
- **Channel adaptation:** Social media leans bold/witty; partner content leans supportive/optimistic; OOH scales by campaign goal.
- **Customer experience mapping:** Detailed emotion scoring across entire user journey from "doom loop" to "delight."
- **Avoidances:** No bee imagery/puns ("Bee thoughtful"); no "shoot"/"shot" language due to gun climate sensitivity.
- **Editing rules:** Be clear, cut adverbs, active voice, make negative requests positive, one exclamation point max, inclusive pronouns.

## Outliers
- Exceptionally detailed customer journey emotional mapping with experience scores -- rare for brand guidelines.
- Voice tone mapped directly to specific journey stages with explicit emotion states (vulnerability to hopefulness).
- Composition/grid system is unusually mathematical and prescriptive for a brand guide, with format-specific margin ratios.
- Photography section emphasizes that photos should look like they were taken on a cell phone -- deliberately anti-polished aesthetic.
- Explicit sensitivity guidance around language (gun-related terms) reflecting social responsibility positioning.

## Quality Score
**4 / 5** -- Comprehensive and well-structured with exceptional depth in messaging/TOV mapping and composition systems. Photography direction is thorough. Loses a point for the relatively minimal color palette documentation and absence of motion/animation guidelines for a digitally-native brand.
